channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by curl (curl).

item.title: CVE-2026-107928 — info leak uploading over WebSockets with GnuTLS

item.title: CVE-2026-94266 — password leak in CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL
item.description: libcurl could accidentally return a URL for `curl_easy_getinfo()`'s `CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL` option containing credentials, even though neither the URL provided to libcurl nor the redirected URL did.

item.title: CVE-2026-87865 — knownhost callback mismatches key as missing
item.description: When libcurl uses libssh2 with a hashed `known_hosts` file, an unrelated initial entry can cause host key validation to report a key *mismatch* as a *missing* key to the `CURLOPT_SSH_KEYFUNCTION` callback.

item.title: CVE-2026-87862 — HSTS cache import drops longer-lived child

item.title: CVE-2026-87861 — cross-origin reuse of a Negotiate connection
item.description: When using ambient user credentials, an HTTP request directed to one origin may be dispatched over a connection previously authenticated via Negotiate for a different origin, leaving the request's intended credentials unused.

item.title: CVE-2026-86415 — auto client cert connection reuse mixup

item.title: CVE-2026-86413 — Negotiate credentials sent to redirected origin
item.description: When using an *ambient user* in a first transfer doing Negotiate authentication and asked to follow redirects, curl could pass on its credential details to an unrelated second origin when asked to redirect there.

item.title: CVE-2026-86410 — redirect to SFTP or SCP bypasses host verification
item.description: A flaw in the curl command line tool's logic makes it only set SSH host verification options when interacting directly using SFTP or SCP, and not as a result of following a redirect.
